instructions.text: Add to them a pound of flour sifted, and a pound of powdered sugar
When it looks quite light, put in a pound of suet finely shred, a pint of milk, a nutmeg grated, and a gill of brandy
Mix with it a pound of currants, washed, picked, and dried, and a pound of raisins stoned and floured
Tie it in a thick cloth, and boil it steadily eight hours

source.author: Mary Randolph
source.originalInstructions:
1. Beat eight eggs very light
2. Add to them a pound of flour sifted, and a pound of powdered sugar
3. When it looks quite light, put in a pound of suet finely shred, a pint of milk, a nutmeg grated, and a gill of brandy
4. Mix with it a pound of currants, washed, picked, and dried, and a pound of raisins stoned and floured
5. Tie it in a thick cloth, and boil it steadily eight hours
